verdict.rationale: The docs confirm that risk management is part of the platform: the onboarding guides mention actioning and managing risks, and there is a Continuous Risk Monitoring page. Risk scoring and owner assignment are documented only for the AI-systems and vendor-risk modules, not for a general enterprise risk register. missing for 10: evidence of a general risk register with scored risks, treatment plans, risk owners, periodic review cycles, explicit risk-to-control mapping, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
